scope: Reconstruction of the previously stated one-uniform branch including fixed-Q mixture/reflection and endpoint equalities; not a new family, independent review or parent adoption.
pure_same_Q: If every actual pure-state local marginal is I/2, the Schmidt decomposition across each one|three split gives two equal Schmidt coefficients; E_i(rho)=I_i tensor rho_bar_i/2 has exactly four nonzero eigenvalues 1/4. For any SAME rank-three Q, Tr Q E_i(rho)<=3/4 and t1<=3. Also T3=I/4 so t3=3/4, t4=3/16, t0<=1, and tilde rho is a state so Tr Q tilde rho<=1. The exact full spinflip identity gives 4t2=Tr Qtilde rho-t0+2t1+8t3-16t4<=1+6+6-3=10; the omitted -t0 is nonpositive, hence t2<=5/2.
exact_gap_and_endpoints: For 0<=p<=1 compare same-Q physical erasure layers with (1,3,3,5/4,3/16). The t2 deficit is at least 1/2 and t3 deficit is exactly 1/2, so R3-Tr QLambda_p rho >= (1/2)(1-p)^2 p^2+(1/2)(1-p)p^3=(1/2)p^2(1-p). Equality of this lower bound is not asserted. At p=0 or p=1 the lower bound vanishes; p=1 actual equality holds for every rho,Q, while p=0 equality iff the support of rho is in ran(Q).
reflection_and_convexity: For 1<=p<=4/3, use p'=2-p and Q'=J_global(Q); the exact full-transpose mirror preserves R3 and the SAME physical rho. Thus the gap is (1/2)(p')^2(1-p')=(1/2)(1-t)^2 t, t=|1-p|. Fix Q while averaging the inequality for any finite convex combination of pure one-uniform inputs; the identical uniform gap remains, so for every such mixed density and 0<t<1 the original k3 comparison is strict. No marginal condition is imposed on an arbitrary mixture other than actual membership in that convex hull.
